description: This header file defines interfaces for reading and writing ButtonStatusInfoType data via RTE (Run-Time Environment) in an AUTOSAR-based CAN communication module. It declares two functions: one for reading button status information from the COM layer and another for writing button status information to the application LED layer.

methods.name: Rte_Read_SigButtonStatusInfo
methods.description: Function to read ButtonStatusInfoType data from the COM (CAN) layer.

methods.name: Rte_Write_PP_ButtonStatusInfo_ButtonStatus
methods.description: Function to write ButtonStatusInfoType data to the Application LED layer.
